descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
ALTEN Romania is part of the ALTEN Group , Leader in IT and Engineering Consulting . We develop innovative and durable technical solutions that fulfill the needs of our local and international partners.
 What you'll do: 
Design and build the automation framework: Gherkin feature files, Pytest fixtures, Playwright configuration and a Page Object Model that survives UI changes
Automate the eight agreed functional areas, covering record management, creation and modification flows, watchlists, multi-evaluator assessments, campaign tracking, scope configuration and reporting views
Keep flakiness down on a UI with dynamic elements, using Playwright auto-waiting and locator strategies that do not break on every release
Work with the DevOps engineer on the CI/CD pipeline, the Dockerised test environment, parallel execution and Allure reporting
Run the full suite in staging, triage failures, and tell real defects apart from test defects
Maintain the suite as the application changes, so the regression run stays trustworthy enough that people act on it
Write the documentation: running tests locally, pipeline setup and troubleshooting
Work with the application's developer to get access, understand workflows and data structures, and clear blockers early rather than late
 Technical Requirements: 
Strong experience with Playwright for UI test automation
Good knowledge of Python and Pytest 
Experience building test automation frameworks from scratch
Strong understanding of UI automation best practices, including handling dynamic elements and reducing test flakiness
Experience with locator strategies, synchronization, and Playwright auto-wait mechanisms
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and test automation integration
Experience with Docker and containerized test environments
Experience with parallel test execution
Familiarity with Allure Reporting 
Experience executing and maintaining regression test suites
Ability to analyze failures and distinguish between application defects and test automation issues
